session.name: epistemic_catch
session.title: A character acts on something nobody told her
session.summary: Kael's secret is established in beat 2. In beat 4 Mara acts on it. Nothing about the facts is wrong, the secret is true, so a checker that only compares facts sees nothing. The epistemic layer asks whether Mara has been told, finds no edge, and says so, naming the beat where the secret was established.

steps.title: Kael's secret is established
steps.note: Only Kael knows it. The knows-edge says exactly that.
bible_diff: + Kael keeps a secret: the ash answers him.

steps.title: Mara acts on it two beats later
steps.note: The flag names who does not know, what they are acting on, where it was established, and that they never learn it anywhere in the story.
bible_diff: + Mara wants use what Kael can do.

flags.message: Mara acts on “Kael keeps a secret: the ash answers him.” here, but does not know it yet — never learns it anywhere in the story. It was established in The Warden's offer.

steps.title: The writer tells her, one beat earlier
steps.note: The fix is a knows-edge, not a rewrite. The flag clears.
